.. py:function:: atlas_indices_for_region(name: Any, index_to_label: Mapping[int, str]) -> list[int]

   Atlas indices a region level refers to — **one, several, or none**.

   Several, because the grouping levels a model is fitted at are not all single parcels. A frame
   grouped by hemisphere reports ``precuneus`` for the average of both, a lobe-grouped one reports
   ``ctx-Left-Frontal-Lobe``, and the ASL tables publish ``ctx-whole-brain``. Each is one number
   that belongs on every parcel it was averaged from — painting it on none, which an exact-match
   lookup does, leaves a lobe-grouped fit with an empty brain. This mirrors
   :func:`nvitk.stats.vascular_map.nodes_for_label`, which expands a hemisphere-melted ``ICA`` onto
   both carotids for the same reason.

   Resolution order: exact parcel → whole-brain / hemisphere → Desikan lobe → nothing.

   Returns ``[]`` for anything the atlas does not cover, which is how a caller tells a region that
   was measured but cannot be drawn (a FLAIR white-matter zone, a whole-head scalar such as
   ``etiv``) from one that simply has no value.


.. py:function:: brainshow(values: Any, *, atlas: AtlasLike, mode: Mode = 'surface', region_order: Sequence[Any] | None = None, labels: Sequence[Any] | None = None, hemisphere: Hemisphere = 'both', cmap: str = 'coolwarm', vmin: float | None = None, vmax: float | None = None, threshold: float | None = None, title: str | None = None, axes: Any | None = None, output_file: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, show: bool = True, atlas_kwargs: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, plot_kwargs: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> Any

   Render brain regions colored by *values* on *atlas* using Nilearn.

   :param values: Per-region numeric values: sequence aligned with ``region_order`` / ``labels``,
                  or mapping from region label (str) or atlas index (int) -> float.
   :param atlas: Preset name or mapping. Volume presets: ``destrieux_2009``, ``destrieux_vol``.
                 Surface presets: ``destrieux_surface``, ``surf_destrieux``.
                 Custom volume: ``{"kind": "volume", "maps": path_or_Nifti1Image, "labels": ...}``.
   :param mode: ``surface`` (mesh / projected volume) or ``volume`` (glass brain / ortho stat map).
   :param region_order: Explicit territory ordering for sequence *values*. ``labels`` is an alias of
                        ``region_order``.
   :param labels: Explicit territory ordering for sequence *values*. ``labels`` is an alias of
                  ``region_order``.
   :param hemisphere: ``both``, ``left``, or ``right`` (masks volumetric painting by MNI x sign).
   :param cmap: Passed to Nilearn plotting (threshold clipped against vmin/vmax when both set).
   :param vmin: Passed to Nilearn plotting (threshold clipped against vmin/vmax when both set).
   :param vmax: Passed to Nilearn plotting (threshold clipped against vmin/vmax when both set).
   :param threshold: Passed to Nilearn plotting (threshold clipped against vmin/vmax when both set).
   :param title: Figure title where supported.
   :param axes: Optional matplotlib axes for volumetric ``plot_stat_map`` only.
   :param output_file: Save figure path when supported by Nilearn.
   :param show: Call matplotlib.pyplot.show() when True and backend allows.
   :param atlas_kwargs: Extra kwargs for Nilearn fetch functions when using presets.
   :param plot_kwargs: Additional kwargs forwarded to Nilearn plotting functions.

   :returns: Nilearn figure handle(s); exact type depends on mode and atlas flavor.
   :rtype: Figure or list

   :raises ImportError: If Nilearn is not installed.
   :raises ValidationError: If inputs are inconsistent with the atlas or mapping rules.


.. py:function:: build_index_to_value(values: Any, *, region_order: Sequence[Any] | None, index_to_label: Mapping[int, str]) -> dict[int, float]

   Turn *values* + *region_order* (or mapping *values*) into atlas index -> float.

   Atlas indices follow the integer labels stored in the volume or surface parcel maps
   (same convention as Nilearn Destrieux atlases).

   Paint voxel-wise stat map from integer atlas labels.


.. py:function:: normalize_region_key(name: Any) -> tuple[str, str]

   Reduce a region name to ``(side, stem)``, whichever vocabulary it was written in.

   *side* is ``"l"``, ``"r"``, or ``""`` for something bilateral or midline; *stem* is the parcel
   with every separator, side token and smoothing suffix removed, so it compares across spellings.

   .. rubric:: Examples

   >>> normalize_region_key("ctx-lh-precuneus")
   ('l', 'precuneus')
   >>> normalize_region_key("ctx_lh_precuneus") == normalize_region_key("lh.precuneus")
   True
   >>> normalize_region_key("left_precuneus")          # T1 spelling
   ('l', 'precuneus')
   >>> normalize_region_key("ctx_bh_precuneus")        # bilateral: belongs on both sides
   ('', 'precuneus')
   >>> normalize_region_key("Left_MCA-8")              # ASL vascular parcel + smoothing kernel
   ('l', 'mca')
   >>> normalize_region_key("ctx-Left-Frontal-Lobe")
   ('l', 'frontallobe')


.. py:function:: resolve_atlas(atlas: AtlasLike, atlas_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None) -> ResolvedAtlas

   Normalize *atlas* spec into :class:`ResolvedAtlas`.

   Presets (volume): ``destrieux_2009``, ``destrieux_vol`` →
   :func:`nilearn.datasets.fetch_atlas_destrieux_2009`.

   Presets (surface): ``destrieux_surface``, ``surf_destrieux`` →
   :func:`nilearn.datasets.fetch_atlas_surf_destrieux`.

   Presets (located, not fetched): ``desikan`` / ``aparc`` →
   :func:`resolve_atlas_preset_desikan`; ``vascular`` / ``arterial`` →
   :func:`resolve_atlas_preset_vascular`. See :mod:`nvitk.viz.atlas_sources` for where they are
   searched for.

   Custom mapping atlas::

       {"kind": "volume", "maps": path_or_img, "labels": {1: "L_MCA", ...}}
       # labels optional; list[str] uses integer indices 0..n-1 as atlas IDs.

   Aliases: ``kind`` may be omitted if ``maps`` is present (infer volume).


.. py:data:: HotspotMode

.. py:function:: show_hotspots(suv: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, mask: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, *, label_ids: Sequence[int] | None = None, hotspot: HotspotMode = 'top_percent', top_percent: float = 0.1, top_k: int | None = None, threshold: float | None = None, max_points: int = 50000, mask_iso: float = 0.5, mask_opacity: float = 0.25, mask_smooth: bool = False, point_size: float = 6.0, cmap: str = 'turbo', notebook: bool = False, show: bool = True, title: str | None = None, auto_threshold_fallback: bool = True, allow_empty_hotspot: bool = False, scalar_bar_title: str = 'SUV', show_min_max_text: bool = True, show_orientation_axes: bool = True) -> Any

   Render SUV hotspots inside a segmentation mask.

   :param suv: suv in **SUV units**, 3D. Either :class:`~nvitk.types.Image` or a NumPy array.
   :param mask: Segmentation mask, 3D, same grid as *suv*. Binary or multi-label.
   :param label_ids: Optional subset of labels (for multi-label masks). None means "all nonzero".
   :param hotspot: Hotspot selection mode.
   :param top_percent: For ``hotspot='top_percent'``: keep voxels within the top *top_percent* SUVs inside ROI.
                       Example: ``0.1`` means top 0.1% (very sparse hotspots).
   :param top_k: For ``hotspot='top_k'``: keep the top K voxels by SUV inside ROI.
   :param suv_threshold: For ``hotspot='threshold'``: keep voxels with SUV >= this value inside ROI.
   :param max_points: Cap number of rendered hotspot voxels (largest SUVs retained).
   :param mask_iso: Isosurface threshold for the ROI volume (binary ROI -> 0.5 is typical).
   :param mask_opacity: ROI surface opacity.
   :param mask_smooth: If True, apply light smoothing to the ROI surface mesh.
   :param point_size: Hotspot point size (rendered as spheres).
   :param cmap: Colormap for SUV scalars.
   :param notebook: If True, configure PyVista plotter for notebooks.
   :param show: If True, immediately show the interactive window.
   :param title: Optional plot title.
   :param auto_threshold_fallback: If True (default), when the first hotspot selection is empty but the ROI is
                                   non-empty, retry once with ``hotspot='threshold'`` and ``threshold=0.1``.
   :param allow_empty_hotspot: If True, when hotspots are still empty after any fallback, return a plotter
                               showing only the ROI surface with a note (for batch HTML reports). If False
                               (default), raise :class:`~nvitk.core.exceptions.ValidationError`.

   :returns: A PyVista plotter instance.
   :rtype: plotter


.. py:class:: FlowshowAnimationOptions

   Time animation; glyph voxel sites can be precomputed for cheap updates.


   .. py:attribute:: precompute_glyph_indices
      :type:  bool
      :value: True


      Cache subsampled voxel coordinates per label so each frame only indexes ``vel[*, t]``.


   .. py:attribute:: auto_play
      :type:  bool
      :value: False


      start ``Play`` widget if possible.

      :type: Desktop

      :type: start timer immediately. Notebook


   .. py:attribute:: animation_fps
      :type:  float
      :value: 8.0



   .. py:attribute:: loop
      :type:  bool
      :value: True


      If False, animation stops at last time frame (desktop timer).


.. py:class:: FlowshowVectorOptions

   How velocity vectors (glyphs) and streamlines are drawn.


   .. py:attribute:: color_mode
      :type:  VectorColorMode
      :value: 'label'


      |v| colormap. ``fixed``: single color.

      :type: ``label``

      :type: color by vessel id (multi-label). ``speed``


   .. py:attribute:: fixed_color
      :type:  str
      :value: '#00A6FB'


      Used when ``color_mode == "fixed"`` (single-label view default accent).


   .. py:attribute:: scale_by_magnitude
      :type:  bool
      :value: False


      If True, arrow length scales with |v| (normalized per frame unless clim fixed).


   .. py:attribute:: scale_factor
      :type:  float
      :value: 0.35


      PyVista glyph scale multiplier when ``scale_by_magnitude`` is True.


   .. py:attribute:: speed_cmap
      :type:  str
      :value: 'turbo'


      Colormap for ``color_mode == "speed"``.


   .. py:attribute:: speed_clim
      :type:  tuple[float, float] | None
      :value: None


      Fixed |v| range for speed colors and optional scale normalization; if None, estimated once from data.


   .. py:attribute:: glyph_opacity
      :type:  float
      :value: 0.88



   .. py:attribute:: streamline_radius
      :type:  float
      :value: 0.12



   .. py:attribute:: streamline_max_time

.. py:function:: flowshow(ap_phase: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, rl_phase: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, fh_phase: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, vessel_mask: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, *, centerline_mask: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray | None = None, stride: int = 4, timepoint: int = 0, notebook: bool = True, show: bool = True, show_all_labels: bool = True, max_glyphs: int = 50000, depth_peeling: bool = False, vector: FlowshowVectorOptions | None = None, animation: FlowshowAnimationOptions | None = None, stream_seed: int | None = 42, dt_seconds: float | None = None, cross_section_volumes: dict[str, nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray] | None = None, centerline_window: int = 5, cross_section_radius_vox: float = 12.0, cross_section_res: int = 0, show_gradient: bool = False, loc_records: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None, voxel_spacing_mm: tuple[float, float, float] | None = None) -> Any

   Interactive 4DFlow viewer.

   :param vector: Glyph / streamline styling (:class:`FlowshowVectorOptions`).
   :param animation: Time animation and glyph index precomputation (:class:`FlowshowAnimationOptions`).
   :param stream_seed: RNG seed for subsampling and streamlines.
   :param dt_seconds: Temporal spacing (seconds) between frames for pathlines. If None and `ap_phase`
                      is an `Image`, we try `ap_phase.temporal_resolution`.
   :param cross_section_res: If > 0, caps oblique slice grid size; if 0 (default), grid size follows the
                             measurement disk radius (~one sample per voxel across the disk diameter).
